<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legislative fast-tracking:</strong> The Lok Sabha passed the SC Judges Amendment Bill in just ten minutes amid ongoing parliamentary disruptions.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Political debut:</strong> Prashant Kishor secured a significant victory in Bankipur, ending the BJP&#x27;s three-decade hold on the seat and signaling a potential shift in regional political dynamics.</li>
  <li><strong>Internal party friction:</strong> Punjab Congress chief Warring has refused to resign despite an escalating factional feud within the state unit.</li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>MSME support:</strong> The Rajya Sabha passed a new bill aimed at addressing and resolving payment delays for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises.</li>
  <li><strong>Judicial clarification:</strong> The Supreme Court has issued a ruling to resolve ongoing confusion regarding the filing of FIRs related to student protests.</li>
</ul>
